title: How To Build A Modern Diffusion Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.33391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The frontier of large language model (LLM) performance has advanced rapidly in recent years, fueled by scaling laws for pretraining on large text corpora. However, mainstream LLMs have fundamental limitations: they generate text autoregressively, producing outputs sequentially from left to right one token at a time. This sequential process leaves parallel GPU hardware underutilized during inference--a bottleneck that has grown acute as progress shifts toward scaling post-training and inference-time compute--and commits irreversibly to each token without the ability to revise earlier mistakes. Discrete diffusion models address these limitations by generating tokens in parallel, starting from a noisy or masked sequence and iteratively refining the entire output over a series of denoising steps. translated_title: 如何构建一个现代扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.33391v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）的性能前沿迅速推进，这得益于在大规模文本语料库上进行预训练的缩放定律。然而，主流LLM存在根本性局限：它们以自回归方式生成文本，从左到右逐个token顺序地产生输出。这种顺序生成过程导致并行GPU硬件在推理期间利用不足——随着研究进展转向扩展后训练和推理时计算，这一瓶颈变得日益严重——并且模型会不可逆地确定每个token，无法修正先前的错误。离散扩散模型通过并行生成token来解决这些局限性：它从噪声或掩码序列开始，并在一系列去噪步骤中迭代地优化整个输出。这种并行生成过程实现了每秒数千个token的生成速度，提供了推理时计算扩展的新维度，并支持……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文系统阐述了如何构建现代离散扩散语言模型，该类模型通过并行去噪生成token，克服了自回归LLM顺序生成导致GPU利用率低和无法纠错的根本局限，实现每秒数千token的生成速度和新的推理时计算扩展维度。
